result:
My verdict on the DG5 round-2 candidate is **PASS**. I checked candidate `sha256:c4f70a80…` (2183 files, source `d3528fc`) on a complete disposable clone, and it matched at the start and at the end of the review. Both of my round-1 findings are verified closed. I raised two new findings, and neither blocks DG5.

**Round-1 findings (`qa-verifier.verifications.json`)**
- **F-DG5-140, closed:** I re-ran my round-1 probe unchanged on the 31 P5 screens. The scoring-defaults screen, and every other one, now has 0 px page-level horizontal scroll at 390 px and with 200 % text, in en and ar.
- **F-DG5-141, closed:**
  - axe reports nothing serious or critical at 390 px, 1366 px or with 200 % text.
  - All 24 scrolling table regions on the P5 screens can take keyboard focus and have a localized name.
  - Real Tab presses reach the source-coverage and rubric tables, and the arrow keys scroll them, including right-to-left in Arabic.
  - The new `p5-reflow-axe.spec.ts` tests what it claims and passed in both locale settings.

**Runs**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks | All exit 0 |
| Unit tests: Node 22 and 24, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | 2335 / 1708 / 259 + 2 skipped in all four runs |
| Integration, run twice (migrations 0001→0097, 846 operations) | 3053 passed + 1 skipped each time |
| `tests/qa` alone | 336/336 |
| Root acceptance specs | 30/30 in each locale setting |
| Demo specs | 12/12 in each locale setting |
| Validators (`--register DG5`, `--pipeline`, `--historical` DG4 to DG1) | All PASS |
| Product journeys | 441/442 in each locale setting; the one failure each time is the p5-forms test (F-DG5-143) |
| REQ-DLV-037 suite counts | A06 27, A07 12, A15 34, A16 30 |
| Export samples | 26 PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/CSV files checked in en and ar, at the level of text and direction markers; nothing could render them visually in this sandbox |

**New findings (`qa-verifier.findings.json`)**
- **F-DG5-142 (Medium, not mandatory, owner frontend-ux-engineer):** observation (f) does not hold on the demo data.
  - Four DG2–DG3 screens fail axe's serious "scrollable-region-focusable" rule at 390 px, in en and ar: the transformation overview, the charter, readiness and the benefit formula page.
  - Keyboard users can't scroll their tables.
  - It isn't a regression, and the requirement it breaks (REQ-S15-012) is due at DG6. It should be fixed before DG6, with the same table fix the P5 screens received.
- **F-DG5-143 (Low, owner frontend-ux-engineer):** the product test `p5-forms.spec.ts:211` depends on row order.
  - Its setup fills the first record in id order, but it opens the first row on screen, which is in dimension order.
  - The two orders often differ, because the ids are random within one millisecond.
  - It failed 2 of 4 times, and passed 6/6 when re-run alone in each locale setting. The product itself behaves correctly.

**Other judgements**
- The orchestrator's a02 fixture change (`6c7f54b`) is acceptable. It adds one audited role assignment, and the test still drives all ten procedures to completion (13/13).
- I accepted observations (a)–(e) and (g), with reasons in check QA-R2-17.
- The seeded G1–G4 approvals show the synthetic-approval label on the gates list, G1, G4 and the approval-decisions page, and in their exported text.

**Problems during the run, all explained in the record**
- One demo test run stalled inside its sandboxed task and was stopped at the 2-hour limit. A fresh start of the same stack was ready in seconds, and the fresh runs passed.
- My round-1 probe first failed to load: in the complete clone, its path filter also matched an evidence copy. I fixed my runner.
- Two of my own keyboard probes failed on a wrong selector; I corrected it and re-ran.
- One round-1 probe run missed the demo banner on one screen per language because the probe checks without waiting. The screenshots show the banner, and two re-runs were clean.

I wrote all four review files (`qa-verifier.json`, `.findings.json`, `.verifications.json`, `.md`) in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-2/`, and the record and findings file validate against their schemas. Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-2/` (42 MB after removing uncited screenshots), and my probe tests are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/tests/round-2/`. I removed the disposable clone.

At the end-of-review check, the other two reviewers' round-2 commits had landed. I saw only their commit titles, after my verdict was set, and read none of their records.
